patterns: APPSC Group-2 repeatedly asks which dynasty built Undavalli / Mogalrajapuram caves (Vishnukundins; traps Ikshvakus, Salankayanas, Pallavas).
Number and sect facts recur: Bhairavakonda = 8 caves, Shaiva (G2 2012, 2008); Undavalli location near Vijayawada (GS 2019).
Questions are short single-fact items with AP dynasties as distractors (Kakatiyas, Reddis, Rashtrakutas).
App goes into cave-by-cave features, architecture terms and Pallava comparison beyond PYQ depth, with some stems that refer to missing passages.
